trufor.label: TruFor (Trust the Forensics)
trufor.description: State-of-the-art detector combining noise fingerprints and visual features for all-round forgery detection

splicebuster.label: Noise Residual Anomaly
splicebuster.description: Detects splicing by finding inconsistencies in the image noise pattern

noisesniffer.label: Noise-Based Forgery
noisesniffer.description: Detects forgery by modelling background noise and finding local deviations

adaptive_cfa_net.label: CFA Pattern Anomaly
adaptive_cfa_net.description: Detects forgery by finding inconsistencies in the camera sensor color filter array pattern

exif_as_language.label: EXIF Metadata Consistency
exif_as_language.description: Detects forgery by finding mismatches between image content and expected camera metadata

psccnet.label: PSCC-Net Spatial Correlation
psccnet.description: Detects and localizes manipulation via progressive spatial-channel correlation analysis
